rationale: PCT01 flagged the extracted pct_of_net_assets quarter sum of 233.14 as outside an expected range, but the raw filing itself reports Total Investments at fair value of 1,417,789 and 233.14% of net assets. The balance sheet reports Total Net Assets of 608,129, so total investments can exceed 100% of net assets for this leveraged BDC. The extracted value matches the source schedule rather than indicating a data error.
